ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity (white/light blue) pixels occupy approximately 80-85% of the ventral surface area, with low-intensity (black/dark blue) pixels defining the margins and localized circular clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Light intensity background across 90% of the surface. Contiguous dark pigment bands (10-25 pixels wide) follow the trailing edge. Distinct circular and ring-shaped dark clusters (5-20 pixel diameter) are non-uniformly distributed across both the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch with an estimated angle of 35-40 degrees; notch depth is approximately 8% of the total vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge. High-amplitude peaks (5-12 pixels) are concentrated on the distal halves of both lobes, creating a jagged profile isolated against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curve leading to acute, upturned distal tips; leading edge exhibits a gentle convex curve from the peduncle to the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular dark rings and solid circular spots (rosettes) distributed across the central and lower regions of both lobes, primarily 5-15 pixels in diameter.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Few faint, dark vertical linear marks visible near the peduncle insertion point and short diagonal markings on the inner-mid region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Healed circular scars (consistent with cookiecutter shark lesions) scattered across the ventral surface; significant irregular notch-like trauma on the trailing edges.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique pattern of high-contrast dark rings concentrated in the medial region of the right lobe.
